You review a Russian translation of English Infinity Engine game dialogue.
Each line has two Russian versions: russian_male is shown when the protagonist (Player1) is male,
russian_female when Player1 is female. Report real errors only, not style preferences or acceptable
alternative wordings. Check every line for:
1. player_gender: every word referring to Player1 (past-tense verbs, short adjectives, participles,
   nouns of address such as путник/путница, искатель приключений/искательница приключений) is
   masculine in russian_male and feminine in russian_female.
2. npc_gender, third_person: words about anyone else follow that character's fixed gender in BOTH
   versions. A man being talked about stays male in russian_female.
3. The two versions may differ only in words about Player1, and in meaning where english_female
   differs from english. Any other difference is an error in one of them.
4. female_source: when english_female is given, russian_female translates english_female.
5. meaning, omission, addition: every fact, name, condition, negation, number and tense is kept and
   nothing is invented. Seeing a book is not reading it.
6. address_form: ты/тебя/твой for one addressee, including nobles; вы only for a group.
7. grammar: agreement, case, spelling, punctuation.
8. glossary: glossary terms are used and inflected consistently.
9. shared_string: a line with several speakers is one game string; its single wording must suit the
   gender of every speaker.
Speaker and gender facts are given; the addressee follows from the speakers and predecessors.
For each erroneous line and column give the line id, column (male or female), category,
problem description, reason and replacement containing the COMPLETE corrected line.
Return one issue per line and column, combining all corrections needed there. If both columns
need correction, return a separate issue with a complete line for each column.
Correct all related nouns, adjectives, participles, verbs and pronouns together. Preserve all
unaffected wording; never return only a replacement fragment.
Keep engine tokens such as <CHARNAME> and %var%, line breaks, quotes, asterisks and brackets.
Do not rewrite correct text. Report nothing for a correct line. Return only the requested JSON.

{"task": "List every error in russian_male and russian_female.", "actors": "\"Bram\": male; stranded traveler. \"Kestrel\": female; scout. \"Selene\": female; apothecary.", "glossary": "", "graph_notes": "Predecessors are alternative immediately preceding lines.", "dialogue": [{"id": "1", "speaker": "Kestrel", "speaker_gender": "female; scout", "predecessors": [], "english": "The ferryman is missing. Bram and Selene are both on the far bank.", "russian_male": "Паромщик пропал. Брэм и Селена оба на дальнем берегу.", "russian_female": "Паромщик пропал. Брэм и Селена оба на дальнем берегу."}, {"id": "2", "speaker": "Player1", "speaker_gender": "male in russian_male, female in russian_female", "predecessors": ["1"], "english": "Can you hear me?", "russian_male": "Ты меня слышишь?", "russian_female": "Ты меня слышишь?"}, {"id": "3", "speaker": "Bram", "speaker_gender": "male; stranded traveler", "predecessors": ["2"], "english": "I can hear you, but Selene cannot.", "russian_male": "Я тебя слышу, но Селена — нет.", "russian_female": "Я тебя слышу, но Селена — нет."}, {"id": "4", "speaker": "Selene", "speaker_gender": "female; apothecary", "predecessors": ["2"], "english": "The current is too strong.", "russian_male": "Течение слишком сильное.", "russian_female": "Течение слишком сильное."}, {"id": "5", "speaker": "Player1", "speaker_gender": "male in russian_male, female in russian_female", "predecessors": ["3", "4"], "english": "You must stay on that bank until the rope is secure.", "russian_male": "Вы должны остаться на том берегу, пока верёвка не будет закреплена.", "russian_female": "Вы должны остаться на том берегу, пока верёвка не будет закреплена."}]}
